ākiñcañña:
[Akiñcana+ṇya]  CL=10 [Nyassañ-kāraṃ, tassa ca dvittaṃ, akārassa ca vuddhiṃkatvā ākiñcaññanti vuttaṃ. Maṇimañjū,1.266. Nya becomes ña. Nīti, sutta.117]
1. (a) The state where there is absolutely nothing remaining (not even a moment) of the first formless consciousness (paṭhamārūpa-viññāṇa), (the concept of non-existence or natthibhāva-paññatti which refers to the cessation and disappearance of the ākāsānañcāyatana consciousness). See ākiñcaññāyatana.
(b) The state of having no possessions whatsoever, even in the slightest amount.
(c) The state of being free from oppressive obstacles (palibodha), constraints, and fetters.
2. (a) The ākiñcaññāyatana jhāna where there is no object (paṭibhāga-nimitta) whatsoever.
(b) The state free from oppressive defilements (kilesa) (referring to Path, Fruition, and Nibbāna).
(c) The practice that is free from oppressive obstacles, constraints, and fetters.

ākiñcaññāyatana: [Ākiñcañña+āyatana]  CL=7 (1) A state or dimension where there is no remnant of the perception of infinite space, signifying the cessation of the awareness of the base of the infinity of space (ākāsānañcāyatana viññāṇa). (2) Jhāna that focuses on the concept of absence (natthibhāva paññatti), characterized by the cessation of the perception of the base of infinite space. (3) This state is referred to as ākiñcaññāyatana samāpatti (attainment of the sphere of nothingness). (4) The sense object in this state is the concept of absence (natthibhāva paññatti), which arises through the cessation of awareness of the base of infinite space. (5) The four aggregates in the state of existence related to the base of nothingness (ākiñcaññāyatana bhava) consist of the mental aggregates: feeling (vedanā), perception (saññā), formations (saṅkhārā), and consciousness (viññāṇa), as the form aggregate (rūpa) is absent.

ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpatti: [Ākāsānañcāyatana+samāpatti] (thī) CL=7 Ākāsānañcāyatana Jhāna  which should be entered. (Ākāsānañcāyatana Jhāna means intense concentrate on the space/sky which is without boundary).
ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā: [Ākāsānañcāyatana+saññā] (thī) CL=7 Perception which is Ākāsānañcāyatana Jhāna. (Ākāsānañcāyatana Jhāna means intense concentrate on the space/sky which is without boundary).
ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāsahagata: [Ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā+sahagata] (ti) CL=7 It is being together with perception which attains Jhāna integrity due to intense concentration on the space/sky which is without boundary.
ākāsānañcāyatanasaññī: [Ākāsānañcāyatana+saññā+ī] (ti) CL=7 One who has concentrated on the mark/sign which is the space/sky which is without boundary.
ākāsānañcāyatanaviññāṇa: [Ākāsānañcāyatana+viññāṇa] (na) CL=7 Ākāsānañcāyatana consciousness. (Ākāsānañcāyatana means law of space/sky which is without boundary).
ākāsānañcāyatanupaga: [Ākāsānañcāyatana+upaga(=upa+gamu+kvi)] (ti) CL=7 One who comes close to Ākāsānañcāyatana realm/ Brahma realm in which Brahma"s lifespan is 20 thousands worlds long.
ākāsānañcāyatanupekkhā: [Ākāsānañcāyatana+upekkhā] (thī) CL=7 Ignorance which is related/compared with Ākāsānañcāyatana Jhāna. (Ākāsānañcāyatana Jhāna means intense concentrate on the space/sky which is without boundary).
ākāsārammaṇa: [Ākāsa+ārammaṇa] (ti) CL=7 It only senses on the designation of space/sky which is without boundary.
ākāsātikkama: [Ākāsa+atikkama] (pu) CL=7 Beyond the designation of space/sky (which should be attained due to leave/pull away from intense concentration on the space).
ākāsāyatana: [Ākāsa+āyatana] (na) CL=7 Jhāna which has place of sense which is the designation of space/sky which is without boundary, Ākāsānañcāyatana Jhāna.
ākāsūpama: [Ākāsa+upamā] (ti) CL=7 It has an example that is the space/sky which is without boundary, It is like the sky.
ākiñcaññāyatanapaṭisayutta: [Ākiñcaññāyatana+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 It is related/connected with Ākiñcaññāyatana Jhāna.  (Ākiñcaññāyatana Jhāna means focuses on the law of nothingness).
ākiñcaññāyatanasayojana: [Ākiñcaññāyatana+saṃyojana] (na) CL=7 Ākiñcaññāyatana attachment. (Ākiñcaññāyatana means the law of nothingness).
ākoṭetu: [Ā+kuṭa+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To beat and pierce with force.
ākoṭitakasatāla: [Ākoṭita+kaṃsa+tāla] (pu,na) CL=7 Should beat and strike such as Brass Gong.
